# Delicious Bites

> Delicious Bites is a restaurant serving wood-fired pizzas, gourmet burgers, fresh wraps, and lavish Arabic platters, with online ordering via WhatsApp and phone.

Located on Rangers Road, near Cash & Carry. Open daily 11am – 11pm. Free home delivery within 3 km (minimum order Rs. 1,000). Contact: 0303 083 83 89 / 052 458 1919.

## Pages

- [Home](https://delicious-bites-delights.vercel.app/): Overview of the restaurant, featured menu items, and highlights.
- [Menu](https://delicious-bites-delights.vercel.app/menu): Full menu with pizzas, burgers, wraps, shawarma, Arabic platters, sides, and drinks, with prices and online ordering.
- [About](https://delicious-bites-delights.vercel.app/about): Information about the restaurant and its story.
- [Contact](https://delicious-bites-delights.vercel.app/contact): Location, hours, phone numbers, and contact options.

## Notes

- Prices are listed in Pakistani Rupees (Rs.).
- Orders can be placed directly through the menu page via WhatsApp.
